summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Task 2 'Race Notice UI' feature for OnCall Foot marketplace. Verified that duplicate booking attempts (HTTP 409) display the exact user-friendly message and keep the booking modal open without redirecting. All requirements met.
passed_tests: API: Login as jane@oncallfoot.com returns valid token
API: First booking creation returns HTTP 201 with numeric bookingId
API: Duplicate booking returns HTTP 409 with numeric bookingId and friendly error message
API: No PostgreSQL internals (23505, constraint names, SQLSTATE) in 409 response
UI: Service selection and booking modal opens correctly
UI: First booking submission succeeds and redirects to /bookings
UI: Duplicate booking submission triggers HTTP 409
UI: Toast displays EXACT message: 'That time was just taken by another booking. Please choose another available time.'
UI: No PostgreSQL internals visible in toast message
UI: Booking modal remains OPEN after 409 (no redirect, no close)
UI: Form data persists in modal after 409 error
